extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: mimic chest, approx. 82 x 60 x 80 cm (lid resting 22 degrees open)
extras.notes: cute, friendly mimic: oak plank chest with gold bands on four round feet, red velvet mouth, round blunt teeth, pink tongue hanging over the front edge; the lid 'mimic-chest_lid' (with the big eyes and pink cheeks) is a separate object with its origin on the rear hinge edge: rotate around local X, +22 degrees closes the mouth, negative angles open it wider (up to about -60); front faces -Y; no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
